name: pscale-nullpair-v2
instr:
**Traffic budget created with pscale throttles almost everything**

We capped our reporting jobs at a quarter of the workers on our Postgres branch:

    pscale traffic-control budget create analytics main --org acme --name reporting --mode enforce --concurrency 25

Once we attached the rule for the reporting app, nearly every reporting query got rejected, even
with the database idle. The dashboard shows the budget with capacity 0, rate 0, burst 0 and
warning threshold 0. We never passed those, and `--help` says an unset limit is unlimited. A
colleague later renamed an older budget with `pscale traffic-control budget update ... --name`,
and its capacity, rate and burst dropped to 0 too.

When we created it, pscale printed the new budget back with a dash in every limit column except
concurrency, so at first we blamed the dashboard.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, as a _test.go file (say
./internal/cmd/trafficcontrol/repro_test.go, next to the code it tests), that fails on the current
code because of this problem (a real test failure, not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added.

I doubt I'm the only one hitting this. Anyt
